subject: Re: Air freight quote request: HAM to BOG
body:
Dear Jonas Kessler,

The cheapest air freight option from HAM to BOG is 1732.65 EUR all-in. This covers air freight only, as you will deliver the shipment to HAM. The rate is based on 661.32 kg chargeable weight (630 kg gross / 3.96 cbm) and is valid today until 08:59 UTC.

With the shipment ready on 28 Nov and a 4-day transit, the estimated arrival is 2 Dec.

Kind regards,
Alex
TALOS Air Freight
